title: Who Gains When the Umpire Is a Machine? Evidence from the Automated Ball-Strike System (ABS)
abstract: arXiv:2610.27576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In 2024 the Korea Baseball Organization became the first top-tier league to replace the home-plate umpires ball-strike judgment with an automated system. Using over a million pitches from 2021 to 2026, we separate the change into the removal of human discretion and the imposition of a new zone geometry. The machine eliminated count-dependent calls, the value of catcher framing and a small advantage for star batters, rents worth only a few runs per player-season. Because the machines zone scales with height and treats every matchup alike, it redistributed strikes toward tall batters and across matchups, but few pitches are exposed to these changes, and their effects on plate-appearance outcomes are precisely estimated and close to zero. Pitchers re-optimized quickly by throwing higher, with left-handers catching up to an existing trend, whereas we find no evidence that batters adjusted. translated_title: 当裁判是机器时，谁会获益？来自自动好球带系统的证据
translated_abstract: 2024年，韩国棒球组织（KBO）成为首个用自动化系统取代主审裁判好坏球判罚的顶级联赛。利用2021年至2026年间超过一百万次投球数据，我们将这一变化分解为人类自由裁量权的消除和新好球带几何规则的施加两个部分。机器消除了依赖于球数的判罚、捕手“接球技巧”的价值以及明星打者的微小优势，这些租金价值每名球员每赛季仅价值几个得分。由于机器的好球带随身高缩放且对每场投打对决一视同仁，它将好球重新分配给高个打者并在不同对决间重新分布，但很少有投球受到这些变化的影响，其对打席结果的影响被精确估计且接近于零。投手通过提高投球高度迅速重新优化，左撇子投手则追赶了这一既有趋势，而我们没有发现打者做出调整的证据。结果表明，取代的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文利用KBO联赛引入自动好球带系统后超过一百万次投球数据，发现机器判罚消除了依赖球数的裁量、捕手接球价值和明星打者优势等微小租金，对打席结果的影响接近于零，只有投手通过提高投球高度迅速做出了调整。
en_tdlr: Using over a million pitches from the KBO's adoption of the Automated Ball-Strike System, this paper shows that machine umpiring eliminated count-dependent calls, catcher framing value, and star-batter rents with near-zero effects on plate-appearance outcomes, and only pitchers re-optimized quickly by throwing higher.
